items.evidence: Adjusted Net Revenue. For Messrs. Schultz, Maw and Johnson, # of their EMBP award was based on a consolidated adjusted net revenue goal.
Adjusted Operating Income. For Messrs. Schultz, Maw and Johnson, # of their total EMBP award was based on a consolidated adjusted operating income goal.
ROIC. For each of our NEOs, ROIC (measured on a consolidated basis) operated as a potential downward modifier of their combined adjusted operating income and adjusted net revenue result.
the number of shares earned is dependent on the achievement of future EPS and ROIC goals
The extent to which performance RSUs vest is based on our achievement of two-year adjusted EPS and ROIC goals.
